purpose: Requirements for additive development: mechanically identifying documents in a parallel state, where old and new specs coexist, and conveying that status to spec consumers so old specs are not used as basis.
summary: Rationale: old specs are not rewritten until implementation completes, so old and new specs coexist
Why a mechanism is needed: parallel state cannot be inferred from content or location, and consumers cannot tell "not passed" from "none exist"
Glossary: parallel state, old spec, spec consumer, implementer
Scope table of spec consumers (implementation, review, upstream generation, merge) with communication status per consumer
Out of scope: decision criteria, merge procedure, preventing missing identifiers, mechanisms outside forge
FNC-001: machine-readable identification, identifier exists only during parallel state, plans carry none
FNC-002: identification result carries state only, never actions to take
FNC-003: communicate parallel-state documents to each consumer before judgment begins, including absence
FNC-004: old spec descriptions are not the current spec in the covered range, regardless of contradiction
FNC-005: identification failure must not be treated as not-parallel and must be reported before implementation
tasks: Designing or revising the additive development mechanism
Implementing tasks that touch documents marked as temporary or parallel state
Reviewing code or documents against requirements and design that may be in parallel state
Generating design, plan, requirements or UX/UI documents from existing specs
Merging parallel-state documents back into old specs
Adding a new spec consumer that needs parallel-state notification
title: REQ-025 差分開発の仕組み 要件定義書
